description: Update TypeScript types to match actual DB schema and create skuStore for SKU browsing state management
steps: Update the SkuMaster interface in src/types/database.ts to match the actual sku_master table columns from baseline/v1.1.5_baseline.sql: sku_id (rename from id), sku_code, product_type (enum: WALL_PANEL/LIGHT/FURNITURE), family_id, category_id, width_mm (nullable), height_mm (nullable), thickness_mm (nullable), depth_mm (nullable), unit_length_mm (nullable), material, colour, finish, pattern_identity (nullable), gh_mm, gv_mm, quantity_mode (nullable, enum: DISCRETE/LINEAR), commercial_attributes (JSONB), status (enum: ACTIVE/INACTIVE), created_by, created_at, updated_at

Add new interfaces to src/types/database.ts: CatalogueEntry (catalogue_entry_id, sku_id, status: INCOMPLETE/READY, created_at, updated_at), CatalogueAsset (asset_id, catalogue_entry_id, asset_type: GEOMETRY/PATTERN/RENDER, version, content_hash, file_reference, status: UPLOADING/VALIDATING/VALID/INVALID, created_at, is_current), FamilyMaster (family_id, name, created_by, created_at), CategoryMaster (category_id, family_id, name, created_by, created_at), SkuCompatibility (compatibility_id, source_sku_id, target_sku_id, relationship_type: REQUIRES/COMPATIBLE_WITH/ALTERNATIVE_TO, directionality: UNIDIRECTIONAL/BIDIRECTIONAL, is_mandatory, status: ACTIVE/INACTIVE, created_at)

Add enums to src/types/database.ts: ProductType (WALL_PANEL, LIGHT, FURNITURE), SkuStatus (ACTIVE, INACTIVE), CatalogueStatus (INCOMPLETE, READY), AssetType (GEOMETRY, PATTERN, RENDER), CompatibilityRelationship (REQUIRES, COMPATIBLE_WITH, ALTERNATIVE_TO)
Add a SkuWithCatalogue type that joins SkuMaster with its CatalogueEntry and the RENDER asset's file_reference (for thumbnail display)
Update any references to the old SkuMaster.id field in projectStore.ts (the assignSku method uses .eq('id', skuId) which should now be .eq('sku_id', skuId))

Create src/stores/skuStore.ts as a Zustand store with state: { skus: SkuWithCatalogue[], families: FamilyMaster[], categories: CategoryMaster[], filters: { productType: ProductType | null, familyId: string | null, categoryId: string | null, material: string | null, colour: string | null, catalogueStatus: CatalogueStatus | null, skuStatus: SkuStatus | null, searchQuery: string }, selectedSkuId: string | null, isLoading: boolean, error: string | null, page: number, pageSize: number, totalCount: number, isBrowserOpen: boolean }

Add skuStore actions: fetchSkus() - queries sku_master joined with catalogue_entry (left join) and fetches current RENDER asset file_reference, applies all active filters and pagination; fetchFamilies() - loads family_master; fetchCategories(familyId?) - loads category_master optionally filtered by family; setFilter(key, value) - updates a single filter and resets page to 0; clearFilters(); setSearchQuery(query); selectSku(id); setPage(page); openBrowser(); closeBrowser()

The fetchSkus action should implement the isSelectable logic from spec Section 27: only return SKUs where sku.status == 'ACTIVE' AND catalogue_entry.status == 'READY' when a catalogue filter is set to READY, but show all when browsing (with status badges)
Export useSkuStore and its types from src/stores/index.ts barrel file

Create src/stores/__tests__/skuStore.test.ts with tests covering: initial state, filter setting/clearing, search query updates, pagination state, selectSku, openBrowser/closeBrowser, fetchSkus mocking fromTable to verify correct query construction with filters
acceptance_criteria: SkuMaster interface has all columns from sku_master table with correct types and nullability
CatalogueEntry, CatalogueAsset, FamilyMaster, CategoryMaster, SkuCompatibility interfaces exist with correct fields
skuStore.fetchSkus correctly constructs Supabase queries with filters applied
All new enums are exported and usable
projectStore.assignSku references sku_id (not id) in its Supabase query
npm run build passes with no type errors
npx vitest run passes all tests including new skuStore tests
findings: Build uses 'unset NODE_OPTIONS' workaround due to missing proxy-bootstrap.js in sandbox. tsc -b and vite build both pass. All 89 tests pass (22 new skuStore tests). tsconfig.tsbuildinfo is updated by the build. ZonePropertiesPanel.tsx updated to use sku.material + sku.colour instead of removed sku.name field.
